description: Answer a general (not booking-specific) travel-upgrade question — how bid/instant/points upgrades work, eligibility rules, bidding strategy, and which airlines, cruise lines, or rail operators offer upgrades. Use this for informational questions only. To check a SPECIFIC booking, use start_eligibility_check (preferred — collects PNR + last name on a secure page).

askedBy.description: Identifier for the calling agent/app (e.g. 'claude-cowork', 'aircanada-bot'). Used for per-partner reporting on which agents ask about their brand.

conversationId.description: Optional stable conversation id — carries the operator in play across follow-up questions (e.g. 'what about the return?').

question.description: The traveler's upgrade question, in natural language.

name: ask_upgrade_agent
